# Virgo

Virgo is a minimalist theme with coordinated light and dark modes and readable typography. Its recorded description names subtle accents, consistent spacing and an uncluttered interface as the means of keeping attention on note content.

![Virgo screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loveminimal/obsidian-theme-virgo/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Virgo"
    author: "loveminimal"
    repo:   "loveminimal/obsidian-theme-virgo"
    slug:   "virgo"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/virgo"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/loveminimal/obsidian-theme-virgo"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loveminimal/obsidian-theme-virgo/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimalist, clean theme for Obsidian with coordinated light and dark modes and readable typography. Keep notes focused with subtle accents, consistent spacing, and an uncluttered interface for distraction-free writing."
}
```
